header.userPrompt:
Persist how each bank statement was extracted.

The extraction ladder already tags its output: AiStatementExtractor.ExtractionResult.source holds the stage that produced the kept result (stamped by StatementExtractionService). Surface that and persist it on drafts and confirmed statements.

1. Add an ExtractionSource enum, mirroring the existing ProductType enum exactly (same library, module/location and style). Four values, stored as these strings: pdf_text, bda_markdown, textract_tables, bda_custom. They correspond 1:1 to the four ladder stages in StatementExtractionService.extract (PDF text; BDA markdown; Textract tables + text + BDA markdown; BDA custom output). Change ExtractionResult.source and the ladder's stamping to use this enum instead of the current Option[String], so each stage name lives in one place. Update StatementPipelineEval (it reads result.source) to match.

2. Define a small, typed ExtractionInfo holding exactly: stage: ExtractionSource, model: String, reconciled: Boolean, discrepancy: Option[String]. No freeform map. Put it where both the server and the shared API models can use it (mirror where ProductType / the draft payload models live).

3. Draft: in ExtractBankStatementDraftAction.toPayload, add the extraction stage to the ready draft payload (which already carries model, reconciled, discrepancy), taken from result.source. Do not fabricate a value when source is absent - leave it optional.

4. Confirmed statement: add a nullable jsonb column extraction_info to the confirmed bank statement table via a single new Play evolution (no !Downs, no DB default, named constraints if any). In ConfirmBankStatementDraftAction, assemble ExtractionInfo from the draft payload and store it through the repository/DAO. Nullable, no backfill.

5. Return extractionInfo in the GetBankStatement API response so it is visible. No frontend/UI work is in scope.

Scope: persistence + API read only. Keep the enum app-side only (a plain string column in Postgres, no Postgres enum type). Add/adjust tests per docs/guide/testing.md.
